info.description: REST API for the Terraform State Manager: analyze, edit, and move Terraform state across existing backends, with CI-driven drift detection and version testing.
info.title: Terraform State Manager API

get.description: Read-only view of configured identity providers (OIDC, SAML, LDAP, mTLS) and the SCIM toggle, including group-to-role mappings. Secrets are omitted.
Paginated list of users with organization role memberships. Requires admin.

post.description: Analyzes a one-off .tfstate (raw JSON body or multipart "file") without storing a source. Requires state:read.
Search-bind authentication against the configured LDAP directory. Sets the session cookie on success.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user, organization memberships, and combined allowed scopes.

post.description: Receives a signed SAML response from the IdP (SP- or IdP-initiated), validates the assertion, provisions the user, and sets the session cookie before redirecting to the frontend callback.

get.description: Returns the SAML Service Provider metadata XML for the named (or first configured) IdP. Used by SAML identity providers during federation setup.

parameters.description: SAML IdP name (defaults to first configured)
parameters.name: idp

get.description: Aggregates RUM and resource/provider/Terraform-version breakdowns across all sources. Requires state:read.

post.description: Dispatches a terraform-plan drift run on the chosen CI pipeline and records it. Inputs are validated server-side. Requires state:drift.
CI job posts drift results here, authenticated by the per-run one-shot X-TSM-Callback-Token. Not a user endpoint.
Dispatches terraform init/plan against pinned Terraform/provider versions on the chosen CI pipeline. Inputs validated server-side. Requires state:execute.

get.description: Returns all organizations as SCIM 2.0 Group resources (up to 200).
Returns a single organization as a SCIM 2.0 Group resource by ID.
Returns a paginated list of users in SCIM 2.0 format. Supports an optional filter (e.g. userName eq "alice@example.com").

post.description: Provisions a new user via SCIM 2.0. Requires userName or emails[0].value; uses externalId as the identity link.

get.description: Returns a single user in SCIM 2.0 format by ID.

put.description: Full replacement of a user via SCIM 2.0 PUT. Setting active=false deactivates the user and removes all organization memberships.

delete.description: Soft-deletes (deactivates) a user by removing all organization memberships. The user record is preserved.

patch.description: Partially updates a user via SCIM 2.0 PATCH operations. Supports the 'replace' op for active, userName, name.formatted, and displayName.

get.description: Returns all configured state-source connections (secrets are never included). Requires state:read.

post.description: Adds a state-source connection (credentials encrypted at rest). Requires sources:manage.

delete.description: Disconnects the source from the State Manager. The underlying backend and its files are not touched. Requires sources:manage.

get.description: RUM, resource-type/provider/module breakdowns, and version info for a state file.

post.description: Non-destructively copies the state at ?key= into a target source. Requires state:transfer.
post.summary: Back up state to another source

post.description: Copies the state to a target, verifies serial/lineage/resource-count parity, and optionally decommissions (empties) the original after a successful backup. Requires state:transfer.
Apply an rm or mv operation through the backup -> write -> audit pipeline. Requires state:write.

put.description: Lock -> backup -> validate (serial/lineage) -> write -> audit. Pass force=true to override serial/lineage checks. Requires state:write.

parameters.description: Report format: json, md, or csv
parameters.name: format

BearerAuth.description: Session JWT. Format: "Bearer {token}". The same token is also delivered as the HttpOnly tsm_auth_token cookie.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization

CallbackToken.description: Per-run one-shot token authenticating a CI job's machine callback (drift/health results).
CallbackToken.name: X-TSM-Callback-Token

CookieAuth.description: HttpOnly session cookie set at login. Mutating requests additionally require the X-CSRF-Token header to match the tsm_csrf cookie (double-submit).
CookieAuth.name: tsm_auth_token
